title: Estimate requests
description: Patients asking for a price, from the portal, your website or your own calls

help.title: About estimate requests
help.overview: A patient can send one request to several clinics. Until they share their contact, you see their first name and country only; talk to them in the request's conversation.

sections.title: On this page
items: Answer within your response target: the portal shows patients how fast clinics usually answer.
Ask for a panoramic X-ray or photos when you need them to quote; the patient sends them to you only.
Open the patient folder once they choose you; it keeps their contact and appointments together.
